2317-6664-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
2317-6664-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

4279-5332-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5332-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-8176--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-8176--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-3693-4247-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-3693-4247-5544-6431.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

728-1669-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

558-4591-8089.description:
Activate Carrion Howler by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1011-2728-5662-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5662-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5662-5686.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

997-1116-1580-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

3457-3990-7791.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Incubation Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7726.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

618-4456-7055-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Thornscape Familiar.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

618-2511-4783.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur trigger from step 3.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

280-4826-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-4826-5702-6850.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2829-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

141-5686-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5686-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

2396-4968-6822.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat.

2034-2741-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2741-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1545-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
1545-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Trostani, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Trostani and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-4927.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

4477-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Greenwarden of Murasa.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
4477-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa, causing you to mill cards equal to Greenwarden of Murasa's power.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2713-3334-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-3334-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

465-643-2079-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

478-804-2821-4249-5089.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-4249-5089.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
478-804-2821-4249-5089.description:
Animate Candelabra using Karn
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

204-1858-2056-2079-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2079-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

188-4067-5467.easyPrerequisites: Lavamancer's Skill attached to Wylie Duke.
188-4067-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
188-4067-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

3489-3821-4520.notablePrerequisites:
Silver-Fur Master does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
3489-3821-4520.description:
Declare Silver-Fur Master as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Peregrine Drake's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U}{B} and returning Silver-Fur Master from the battlefield to your hand, putting Peregrine Drake onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Silver-Fur Master's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand, putting Silver-Fur Master onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

650-1133-3518-5112.notablePrerequisites:
It is your upkeep step.
Mairsil does not have an Aura attached to it.
650-1133-3518-5112.description:
During your upkeep step, activate Mairsil using Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Mairsil.
Activate Mairsil using Lion's Eye Diamond's ability by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
When Mairisil dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Mairisil from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

662-2043-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {8}{U}{U}.
662-2043-2556-4276.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Mnemonic Wall to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {9}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Turnabout choosing its other modes.

4050-4424-4570.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timebender, adding {U}.
When Timebender dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Timebender from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Timebender's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Timebender triggers, either removing up to two time counters from a card, or putting two time counters onto a suspended card or a permanent with a time counter on it.
Repeat.

371-1849-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests.
371-1849-5003.description:
Activate five Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it.
Llanowar Druid dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability from step 2, untapping all Forests.
Repeat.

890-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Palladium Myr.
Palladium Myr does not have summoning sickness.
890-3263-4222.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Palladium Myr.
Repeat.

500-523-2557-4840.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Myr Battlesphere and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, creating thirty-two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Hellkite Tyrant triggers, causing you to win the game.

2178-3327-4660-4871.manaNeeded: {R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2178-3327-4660-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
2178-3327-4660-4871.description:
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing three other creatures, as well as paying commander tax, if applicable.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to have Dargo returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Dargo dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Thornbite Staff.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thornbite Staff trigger, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, dealing damage equal to the sacrifice creature's power to any target and returning Dargo to the command zone.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R}.
Repeat from step 3.

4131-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Basalt Monolith.
4131-5149.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
